input.quote: 11.1 Term. The term of this Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and shall continue in full force and effect for an initial period of five (5) years. Thereafter, this Agreement shall automatically renew for subsequent one (1) year periods unless either party provides the other party with written notification at least thirty (30) days prior to the expiration of the initial five (5) year term or any one (1) year renewal thereof of its intention to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 11 gives a five-year initial term with automatic one-year renewals, and the only exit rights are for uncured material breach or insolvency (11.2) plus non-renewal at the end of a term (11.1). Corio therefore has no termination-for-convenience right during a multi-year committed term, which the playbook treats as walk-away territory and fails the fallback (60–90 days' notice with a capped fee). Commerce One likewise has no mid-term convenience right, so no cut-back of the Vendor side is needed. Because annual maintenance/support and MarketSite.net access fees are paid in advance (Exhibit B payment terms), we added a 30 days' notice convenience right with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees as new Section 11.4, matching the preferred position, and offered 60 days' notice as a fallback in the comment.

proposal.summary: Add Corio convenience termination right on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The five-year term gives us no way out except for breach, so we have added a convenience exit on thirty (30) days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid license, maintenance and access fees, consistent with our playbook position. If you need a longer runway, we can move to sixty (60) days' notice.

ops.text: Termination for Convenience. Corio may terminate this Agreement, in whole or in part, for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Commerce One, without penalty, early termination fee or other charge. In such event, Commerce One shall refund to Corio, within thirty (30) days after the effective date of termination, any prepaid fees (including any prepaid license, Software Maintenance and Support and MarketSite.net access fees) allocable to the period after the effective date of termination.
